title: Bandhan Tree
description: One tree at dusk, carrying everybody's threads. Walk around it, tap any thread to read who tied it and what they wished, then tie your own — pick a silk, pick a blessing, and it goes up for everyone who visits after you. The tree is grown from a fixed seed so the same twig is the same twig on every phone, which is how a thread can be three small numbers and still land exactly where its owner tied it. Yours keeps a small light on it so you can find it again. Fireflies, wind in the leaves, and a temple bell somewhere over the fields.
